name: company-tearsheet
title: Draft company review
for_each: select id,name from companies where not archived order by name

sections.title: Reported metrics
sections.note: Internal management information. Check review state and period before use.
sections.sql: select metric,period,value,currency,review_state,source from latest_observations where company_id=$1 order by period desc,metric

sections.title: Updates
sections.sql: select note,source,actor,created_at from updates where company_id=$1 order by created_at desc

name: collection-request
title: Draft collection checklist
for_each: select id,name from companies where not archived order by name

sections.title: Figures to obtain or review
sections.note: Local checklist only. Nothing is sent.
sections.sql: select metric,period,due,state from collection_week where company_id=$1 and state<>'approved' order by period,metric

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,closure from actions where company_id=$1 order by due

name: evidence-review
title: Portfolio evidence review
for_each: select id,name from companies order by name

sections.title: Figure evidence
sections.sql: select metric,period,source,actor,review_state,reviewer,review_evidence from latest_observations where company_id=$1 order by period desc,metric
